s.how: Warm 16 blinis in the oven for 3 minutes. Top each with a spoon of crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon and snipped chives and serve on a big platter.

s.note: the cookies Santa eats at every house
s.how: Beat 250g butter and 110g sugar until pale, then mix in 360g plain flour. Press into a lined tin, prick all over and bake at 150C for 45 minutes. Cut into fingers while warm.

m.how: Roast a 2kg beef rib at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 1 hour for medium rare. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside and make gravy from the pan juices and 300ml stock.

w.how: Tear a sponge cake into a glass bowl and scatter with 250g mixed berries. Pour over 500ml custard, top with 300ml whipped cream and chill for an hour.

d.note: Santa drinking at the pub on Christmas Eve
d.how: Chill 4 pints of dark ale and pour into cold glasses. Have 1.25L lemonade ready over ice for the kids and anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
